verdict.rationale: gstack ships a top-level routing skill that 'sends any gstack request to the right skill' and embeds trigger aliases in skill files such as /qa. Its domain skills are also automatically injected into prompt context for matching hosts, which is product-level context-driven activation. However, the evidence does not document how skill descriptions are engineered for reliable automatic activation across the full skill set, and there is no hands-on corroboration that the right skill fires at the right moment. Missing for 10: documented description-engineering approach across all skills, evidence of automatic triggering from task context without explicit invocation, independent or hands-on verification of activation accuracy.

support.subject: As a developer, installed skills trigger automatically from task context, with descriptions engineered so the agent activates the right skill at the right moment

citations.quote: Sends any gstack request to the right skill (planning, review, QA, shipping, debugging, docs, security, design).
Voice triggers (speech-to-text aliases): "quality check", "test the app", "run QA".
future sessions on that host get the note injected into their prompt context.
